_comment: PhantomNet Sprint Config — Week 24 (Month 6 Week 4: Final Polish + Submission, Days 56-60)
milestone_description: Advanced features, CVE mapping, audit logging, system hardening, comprehensive E2E testing, and final V3.0 production delivery.

tasks.Title: Final Code Cleanup — Backend Core, Sentinel Service, and API Layer
tasks.Objective: Perform comprehensive final code cleanup across all backend modules — remove debug prints, unused imports, TODO comments, dead code, and ensure consistent logging, type hints, and docstrings throughout sentinel/, api/, and core backend files.
Tasks: Audit and clean sentinel/sentinel_service.py, sentinel/mitre_mapper.py, sentinel/rule_generator.py, sentinel/playbook_generator.py — remove debug prints, unused imports, TODO/FIXME comments.
Audit and clean api/sentinel.py, api/taxii.py — verify all endpoints have proper error handling, type hints, and docstrings.
Audit main.py, backend/main.py — remove unused imports, dead code paths, and commented-out experimental code.
Verify all Python files pass flake8/pylint linting with zero warnings on critical rules.
Deliverables: Clean, production-ready backend codebase with zero debug artifacts.
Warnings: **Do NOT** remove or modify any production logging statements (logger.info, logger.warning, logger.error) — only remove print() debug statements.
**Do NOT** remove any existing unit test files or test fixtures during cleanup.

tasks.Title: Final Code Cleanup — Rule Generator, TAXII, and Security Tests
tasks.Objective: Perform final code cleanup across rule_generator.py, TAXII endpoints, security test files, and all security-related modules — ensure production-grade code quality with no debug artifacts.
Tasks: Clean sentinel/rule_generator.py — remove debug prints, unused variables, TODO comments, and verify consistent Snort/Sigma rule formatting.
Clean api/taxii.py — verify TAXII 2.1 spec compliance, remove experimental code, ensure proper content-type headers.
Clean all test files in tests/ related to security (test_rule_generator.py, test_taxii.py, test_stix_enhanced.py) — remove skipped/disabled tests, fix deprecation warnings.
Verify all security imports are used and no circular dependencies exist in sentinel/ package.
Deliverables: Clean, production-ready security codebase with verified rule generation and TAXII endpoints.

tasks.Title: Final Code Cleanup — Playbook Generator, LLM Service, and Templates
tasks.Objective: Perform final code cleanup across playbook_generator.py, llm_service.py, Jinja2 templates, and ML model files — remove debug artifacts and ensure clean, maintainable AI/ML codebase.
Tasks: Clean sentinel/playbook_generator.py — remove debug prints, unused template variables, TODO comments.
Clean sentinel/llm_service.py — remove experimental prompts, ensure timeout/fallback logic is clean.
Audit all Jinja2 templates in sentinel/templates/ — remove draft comments, verify consistent formatting across all .md.j2 files.
Clean ml_models/ and experiments/ — remove unused model checkpoints, experimental scripts, and temporary data files.
Deliverables: Clean, production-ready AI/ML codebase with polished templates and LLM service.

tasks.Title: Final Code Cleanup — React Components, Console Logs, and Unused State
tasks.Objective: Perform final code cleanup across all React components in frontend-dev/ — remove console.log statements, unused state variables, commented-out JSX, and ensure consistent component patterns.
Tasks: Remove all console.log, console.warn, console.error debug statements from React components.
Remove unused imports, unused state variables (useState/useEffect), and dead code paths in all .jsx files.
Audit src/components/sentinel/ — PlaybookViewer.jsx, PlaybookCard.jsx, MitreMatrix.jsx, RulePreview.jsx, ApprovalControls.jsx — ensure clean prop drilling and consistent error boundaries.
Verify all CSS/styles are referenced and no orphaned stylesheets exist in src/pages/ or src/components/.
Deliverables: Clean, production-ready React frontend with zero console debug artifacts.

tasks.Title: Version Bump, Changelog, and Release Notes for V3.0.0
tasks.Objective: Prepare formal release artifacts — bump version to 3.0.0 across all configuration files, finalize CHANGELOG.md with comprehensive Month 1-6 entries, and author release notes.
Tasks: Bump version to 3.0.0 in package.json, setup.py/pyproject.toml (if present), docker-compose.yml labels, and README.md badges.
Finalize CHANGELOG.md with comprehensive entries for all 6 months of development — features, fixes, and breaking changes.
Author GitHub Release Notes (draft) summarizing key V3 capabilities: Sentinel Layer, LLM Integration, TAXII 2.1, ATT&CK Matrix, PDF Export, Batch Operations.
Tag the release commit message format: 'Release v3.0.0 — PhantomNet Sentinel V3'.
Deliverables: Updated CHANGELOG.md with complete V3 history.
Version bumped to 3.0.0 across all config files.

tasks.Title: Verify Docker Deployment from Scratch
tasks.Objective: Perform a clean Docker deployment verification — build from scratch with docker-compose up --build, verify all services start correctly, test end-to-end pipeline in containerized environment.
Tasks: Run docker-compose down -v to remove all existing containers and volumes.
Execute docker-compose up --build and verify all services (backend, frontend, honeypots) start without errors.
Test end-to-end pipeline in Docker: attack simulation -> ML detection -> Sentinel playbook generation -> Dashboard visibility.
Document any Docker-specific issues, environment variable gaps, or missing dependencies in deployment checklist.
Deliverables: Updated docker-compose.yml / Dockerfile if fixes needed.
Warnings: **Do NOT** modify docker-compose.prod.yml without updating docker-compose.yml equivalently — both must stay in sync.

tasks.Title: Verify Fresh Install and First-Run Experience
tasks.Objective: Simulate a first-time user experience — clone repository from scratch, install all dependencies, run the application, and verify the dashboard loads with zero pre-existing data.
Tasks: Clone repository to a fresh directory (git clone).
Install Python backend dependencies (pip install -r requirements.txt) and verify no missing packages.
Install frontend dependencies (npm install in frontend-dev/phantomnet-dashboard/) and verify clean build.
Run backend (uvicorn) and frontend (npm run dev), verify dashboard loads at localhost:5173 with empty/seed data.
Document any missing setup steps, environment variable requirements, or first-run issues.
Deliverables: Updated README.md quickstart if gaps found.

tasks.Title: Final Screenshot Set for README and Project Report
tasks.Objective: Capture a comprehensive set of high-resolution screenshots of every dashboard page, Sentinel features, and key UI states for inclusion in README.md and the final project report.
Tasks: Capture screenshots of: Overview Dashboard, Honeypot Monitor, ML Analytics, Sentinel Dashboard (list view), Sentinel Playbook Viewer (detail view).
Capture screenshots of: ATT&CK Matrix heatmap, Campaign Timeline, Batch Approval workflow, PDF Export dialog, Dark/Light theme comparison.
Organize all screenshots in docs/images/ with descriptive filenames (e.g., sentinel_dashboard_dark.png, mitre_matrix_heatmap.png).
Update README.md to embed the latest screenshots replacing any outdated placeholders.

tasks.Title: Full System Test on Clean Environment
tasks.Objective: Execute a comprehensive full-system test on a clean environment with a fresh database and no cached data — verify every component of the pipeline works from cold start.
Tasks: Reset database to clean state (delete phantomnet.db, let system recreate on startup).
Start all services (backend, frontend, honeypots) and verify clean initialization.
Execute complete attack simulation pipeline: SSH brute force, SQL injection, port scan, FTP exfiltration — verify each generates correct Sentinel playbooks.
Verify all dashboard pages render correctly with freshly generated data — no stale cache artifacts.
Deliverables: Full system test report with pass/fail for each pipeline stage.
Warnings: **Back up the existing phantomnet.db** before resetting — copy to phantomnet.db.backup before deletion.

tasks.Title: Full System Test — Security and TAXII Verification
tasks.Objective: Execute security-focused system tests on the clean environment — verify TAXII feed serves STIX data, all rule exports work, and API security hardening is intact.
Tasks: Test TAXII 2.1 endpoints: discovery, collections, objects retrieval with taxii2-client library.
Verify Snort and Sigma rule exports — download ZIP, validate rule syntax for all generated rules.
Test API security: verify rate limiting on sentinel generation, proper error responses for invalid inputs, no SQL injection in search endpoints.
Verify PDF export generates valid PDF files for all playbook types.

tasks.Title: Full System Test — ML Pipeline and LLM Verification
tasks.Objective: Execute ML/AI-focused system tests — verify ML model inference, LLM graceful degradation without Ollama, quality scoring, and campaign timeline data accuracy.
Tasks: Verify ML model loads correctly and produces valid threat scores for all attack patterns.
Test LLM graceful degradation: stop Ollama service, verify system generates template-only playbooks without errors or crashes.
Verify quality scoring produces consistent scores across multiple runs with same input data.
Test campaign timeline API returns accurate event density data matching database records.

tasks.Title: Full System Test — Complete Demo Recording from Start to Finish
tasks.Objective: Record a complete end-to-end demo from system startup to final export — this serves as the backup demo recording and validates the full user journey.
Tasks: Record system startup sequence: backend initialization, frontend loading, honeypot status verification.
Record complete attack → detection → playbook pipeline: inject attacks, show real-time ML scoring, navigate to Sentinel dashboard.
Record SOC analyst workflow: review playbook, inspect ATT&CK mapping, approve playbook, export as PDF and STIX.
Save recording in demos/ directory with descriptive filename (e.g., demo_full_system_v3_final.mp4).
Deliverables: Complete backup demo recording in demos/.

tasks.Title: Presentation Rehearsal — Architecture and Lead Section
tasks.Objective: Conduct presentation rehearsal for the Architecture and System Design section — practice live demonstration, refine talking points, and coordinate with team on handoff transitions.
Tasks: Rehearse Architecture section: system overview, layered micro-architecture, technology stack justification.
Practice live demo segment: cold start → attack injection → playbook generation in under 3 minutes.
Coordinate team handoff transitions: define speaking order (Architecture → Security → AI/ML → Frontend).
Fix any last-minute issues discovered during rehearsal — document critical fixes needed.
Deliverables: Rehearsal notes with timing per section.

tasks.Title: Presentation Rehearsal — Security and Threat Detection Section
tasks.Objective: Conduct presentation rehearsal for the Security Features and Threat Detection section — practice demonstrating TAXII feeds, IDS rules, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping accuracy.
Tasks: Rehearse Security section: honeypot protocol coverage, signature detection, MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
Practice live demo segment: TAXII feed discovery with external client, rule export and validation.
Demonstrate Snort/Sigma rule quality and STIX 2.1 bundle structure.
Fix any last-minute security-related issues discovered during rehearsal.

tasks.Title: Presentation Rehearsal — ML Pipeline and AI Integration Section
tasks.Objective: Conduct presentation rehearsal for the Machine Learning and AI Integration section — practice demonstrating ML inference, LLM narrative generation, and quality scoring.
Tasks: Rehearse AI/ML section: anomaly detection models, feature engineering, F1-score benchmarks.
Practice live demo segment: show ML scoring in real-time, LLM narrative vs template-only comparison.
Demonstrate quality scoring algorithm and campaign timeline visualization.
Fix any last-minute AI/ML issues discovered during rehearsal.

tasks.Title: Presentation Rehearsal — Dashboard Design and UX Section
tasks.Objective: Conduct presentation rehearsal for the Frontend Design and User Experience section — practice live dashboard walkthrough, theme switching, and interactive feature demonstration.
Tasks: Rehearse Frontend section: React architecture, component library, real-time polling, responsive design.
Practice live dashboard walkthrough: navigate all pages, demonstrate dark/light theme switch, show batch operations.
Demonstrate ATT&CK heatmap interaction, campaign timeline, playbook comparison view.
Fix any last-minute UI issues discovered during rehearsal.

tasks.Title: Final Git Push — Tag Release v3.0.0 and Submit Project
tasks.Objective: Execute the final git workflow: commit all changes, create annotated v3.0.0 tag, push to remote, create GitHub Release with release notes, and formally submit the project.
Tasks: Run final git status — ensure working tree is clean with all changes committed.
Create annotated git tag: git tag -a v3.0.0 -m 'PhantomNet Sentinel V3 — Final Release'.
Push all branches and tags: git push origin main --tags.
Create GitHub Release from v3.0.0 tag with compiled release notes, demo video links, and download assets.
Formally submit project per submission requirements.
Deliverables: GitHub Release page with release notes.
Warnings: **Ensure ALL team members have pushed their final commits** before creating the release tag.
**Do NOT force-push** to main — use merge commits only.

tasks.Title: Final Security Checklist Sign-Off and Release Verification
tasks.Objective: Complete the final security checklist — verify no sensitive data in repository, all API endpoints secured, Docker images clean, and TAXII/STIX compliance confirmed.
Tasks: Scan repository for accidentally committed secrets, API keys, or credentials (check .env, config files, git history).
Verify .gitignore covers all sensitive files: .env, *.db, mlruns/, __pycache__/, node_modules/.
Run final TAXII interoperability test and confirm STIX 2.1 bundle compliance.
Sign off on Security Checklist for v3.0.0 release.
Deliverables: Confirmation of no leaked credentials in repository.

tasks.Title: Final ML Model and LLM Verification Sign-Off
tasks.Objective: Complete final verification of ML model artifacts, LLM configuration, and AI documentation — ensure all model files are properly versioned and documentation is accurate.
Tasks: Verify ML model files in models/ are the final trained versions with correct accuracy metrics.
Verify LLM configuration defaults are production-safe: SENTINEL_LLM_ENABLED=false by default, timeout values reasonable.
Confirm docs/llm_integration.md and docs/playbook_templates.md are accurate and match current implementation.
Sign off on AI/ML release readiness for v3.0.0.

tasks.Title: Final Frontend Build Verification and Project Submission Celebration
tasks.Objective: Run final frontend production build, verify no build warnings or errors, confirm all assets are optimized, and celebrate successful V3 delivery with the team! 🎉
Tasks: Run npm run build in frontend-dev/phantomnet-dashboard/ — verify zero build errors and zero critical warnings.
Verify all static assets (images, fonts, icons) are included in the build output.
Confirm all route paths work correctly in production build (test with npm run preview if available).
Celebrate completion of PhantomNet V3! 🎉 Document lessons learned and team retrospective notes.
